why: Both share the same light birch table, black chairs and white bell pendant, which suit the request and room well. A's closed low sideboard has a white body and pale wood fronts that echo the white walls and kitchen cabinetry, with the gold legs as the only slight departure from plain Nordic. B's open pine cube unit reads more as a bookcase than a sideboard, and its yellow knotty pine clashes with the birch table and greige floor.
